Name: Sanji as Gus (for Content Patcher)
Author: Pir8tHunt3rZ0r0
AuthorLabel: Created by Xerxes - updated for CP by Pir8tHunt3rZ0r0
Description:
This is a visual mod that replaces Gus' portrait and sprite with Sanji from One Piece. Here is the original mod - https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1769?tab=description.

To use, Content Patcher is required. Once you have that, just drop it into your Mods folder and it should work.
